A memorable cycle ahead, a short update
The subject is pet carriers
Urgent notice for travelers

Travelers must review pet carrier rules before departure, because unsafe or incomplete carriers can delay boarding and put animals at risk. The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways expects every passenger to check fittings, ventilation, and secure closures before arrival at the airport.

The desk will help travelers who are uncertain, and supervisors will listen carefully when a concern is raised. <<FACT F056>> Carrier condition must be sound, and the animal must be calm, contained, and ready for inspection. Keep all papers together and follow staff directions without delay.

The quarantine room at Thornwick is limited in space. <<FACT F028>> This matters when an animal needs separate handling, so travelers should warn staff early if there is any health concern. <<FACT F082>> Bring only approved equipment, and do not rely on last-minute changes.

For immediate guidance, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel.
